title: The Pumice Stone Sendoff
description: At midsummer, three generations gather at the crater lake to float fern-topped pumice stones. The youngest sets the last one on the water.
alt: A child and two adults crouch on a rocky shore, releasing porous gray stones topped with green ferns onto a turquoise crater lake.
pairing: A midsummer lakeside holiday × a procession of floating pumice stones
